claims: Justin Rose has won one major championship.
Justin Rose won the 2013 U.S. Open at Merion Golf Club.
Justin Rose is an English golfer.
Justin Rose won the Olympic Gold medal in 2016.
Justin Rose finished 2nd/T2 at the Masters Tournament in 2015, 2017, and 2025.
Justin Rose finished 2nd at the Open Championship in 2018 and 2024.
Justin Rose finished T3 at the PGA Championship in 2012.
Justin Rose is a former world number one.
